items.informal_name: Cardinality Equals Sum of Fiber Cardinalities in Finite Sets
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq M] {f : ι → M} {s : Finset ι} {t : Finset M},
  Set.MapsTo f ↑s ↑t → s.card = ∑ b ∈ t, {a ∈ s | f a = b}.card
items.informal_description: For a finite set $ s $ of type $ \iota $, a function $ f : \iota \to M $, and a finite set $ t $ of type $ M $ such that $ f $ maps $ s $ into $ t $, the cardinality of $ s $ is equal to the sum over all $ b \in t $ of the cardinality of the set $ \{ a \in s \mid f(a) = b \} $. In symbols: $ \#s = \sum_{b \in t} \#\{ a \in s \mid f(a) = b \} $.

items.informal_name: Cardinality Equals Sum of Preimage Cardinalities
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq M] (f : ι → M) (s : Finset ι),
  s.card = ∑ b ∈ Finset.image f s, {a ∈ s | f a = b}.card
items.informal_description: For a finite set $ s $ of elements of type $ \iota $, a function $ f : \iota \to M $ where $ M $ has decidable equality, the cardinality of $ s $ is equal to the sum over each element $ b $ in the image of $ f $ applied to $ s $ of the cardinality of the set $ \{ a \in s \mid f(a) = b \} $. In symbols, $ \#s = \sum_{b \in f(s)} \# \{ a \in s \mid f(a) = b \} $.

items.informal_name: Cardinality of Preimage Equals Sum of Fiber Cardinalities
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {f : ι → M} {s : Finset M},
  (∀ b ∈ s, {a | f a = b}.Finite) → Nat.card ↑(f ⁻¹' ↑s) = ∑ b ∈ s, Nat.card { a // f a = b }
items.informal_description: If every element $ b $ in the finite set $ s $ has a finite preimage under $ f $, then the cardinality of $ f^{-1}(s) $ is equal to the sum of the cardinalities of $ f^{-1}(b) $ for all $ b \in s $. This can be expressed as $ |f^{-1}(s)| = \sum_{b \in s} |f^{-1}(b)| $.

items.informal_name: Sum of Fiber Cardinalities Equals Cardinality of Preimage
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_5} [inst : DecidableEq κ] (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (g : ι → κ),
  ∑ j ∈ t, {i ∈ s | g i = j}.card = {i ∈ s | g i ∈ t}.card
items.informal_description: For any finite set $s$ of type $\iota$, finite set $t$ of type $\kappa$, and function $g : \iota \to \kappa$, the sum over all $j \in t$ of the cardinality of the fiber ${i \in s \mid g(i) = j}$ equals the cardinality of the set ${i \in s \mid g(i) \in t}$. In symbols: $\sum_{j \in t} \#\{i \in s \mid g(i) = j\} = \#\{i \in s \mid g(i) \in t\}$.

items.informal_name: Cardinality Inequality for Finite Sets with Bounded Preimages
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq β] {f : α → β} (s : Finset α) (n : ℕ),
  (∀ b ∈ Finset.image f s, {a ∈ s | f a = b}.card ≤ n) → s.card ≤ n * (Finset.image f s).card
items.informal_description: For any function $ f : \alpha \to \beta $, finite set $ s \subseteq \alpha $, and natural number $ n $, if every element in the image $ f(s) $ has at most $ n $ preimages in $ s $, then the cardinality of $ s $ satisfies $ |s| \leq n \cdot |f(s)| $.
